items.desc: Finland and Norway have called Putin about ending the Ukraine war, drawing Danish criticism. The dispute highlights divisions over European engagement with Moscow ahead of planned US-led peace talks.

items.title: Jordan acknowledges civilian casualties in Syria airstrike against 'Islamic State'
items.titleOrig: Jordan acknowledges civilian casualties in Syria airstrike against 'Islamic State'
items.desc: A Jordanian government spokesman has expressed "regret" over civilian casualties in an airstrike it said was targeting "IS" militants.

items.title: DR Congo reports over 10,000 Ebola cases as the outbreak spreads abroad, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo virus
items.titleOrig: DR Congo reports over 10,000 Ebola cases as the outbreak spreads abroad, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo virus
items.desc: DR Congo has reported more than 10,000 Ebola cases and nearly 4,900 deaths. The outbreak involves a virus for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, complicating efforts to contain its spread.

items.title: Germany's Merz says erosion of global order means middle powers in Europe and Asia must be more assertive
items.titleOrig: Germany's Merz says erosion of global order means middle powers in Europe and Asia must be more assertive
items.desc: During a visit to Singapore, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said Europe and Germany want to increase free trade with open competition, reliability and a rules-based order.

items.title: Two men face UK national security charges following an incident near RAF Fairford, with police suspecting Iranian state involvement
items.titleOrig: Two men face UK national security charges following an incident near RAF Fairford, with police suspecting Iranian state involvement
items.desc: British prosecutors have charged two men over an incident near RAF Fairford in September. Police suspect Iranian involvement in the case at a base used for US strikes on Iran.

items.title: Police in northern Germany search for suspects after car ramming overnight injures several
items.titleOrig: Police in northern Germany search for suspects after car ramming overnight injures several
items.desc: A person intentionally drove into a group of people in a northern German town, police have said. Three people have been taken into custody in what police said was likely a gang confrontation.

items.title: India news: Arunachal sees fresh violence over proposed dam
items.titleOrig: India news: Arunachal sees fresh violence over proposed dam
items.desc: More violence erupted in India's northeastern state of Arunachal Pradesh over proposed hydroelectric projects that locals are protesting. Also, India's top court will hear pleas against the poll body chief.

items.title: Brazil elections: Merz, world leaders congratulate Lula on his win
items.titleOrig: Brazil elections: Merz, world leaders congratulate Lula on his win
items.desc: Brazilian President Lula secured a surprise win over far-right challenger Flavio Bolsonaro, whose party recognizes Lula's election victory.

items.title: Ukraine and Russia begin Oleshky ceasefire for aid mission
items.titleOrig: Ukraine and Russia begin Oleshky ceasefire for aid mission
items.desc: Around 2,000 people remain stranded in the city of Oleshky, facing severe shortages of food and medicine. The Russian-occupied town has been devastated by fighting and flooding since Moscow's invasion in 2022.

items.title: US seeks new charges against former FBI chief James Comey
items.titleOrig: US seeks new charges against former FBI chief James Comey
items.desc: The Trump administration accuses the former FBI director of leaking classified information a decade ago. Comey denies wrongdoing, while his lawyers argue the case is legally invalid and comes too late.

items.title: England and Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane wins Ballon d'Or
items.titleOrig: England and Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane wins Ballon d'Or
items.desc: The England captain ends his country's 25-year wait for the prestigious award after scoring 73 goals for club and country last season, beating competition from Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe.
